about.metaDescription: Real English. Real conversations. A brighter future. Learn practical English online with qualified American English teachers.
about.title: Real English. Real Conversations. A Brighter Future.
about.intro1: At Amerivo English, we believe learning English should be more than memorizing vocabulary and studying grammar. It should help you speak with confidence, communicate naturally, and open doors to new opportunities.
about.intro2: Amerivo English is an online English-learning platform connecting learners with qualified teachers for personalized, practical English lessons designed around real life.
about.intro3: Whether you’re learning English for work, travel, education, relationships, or simply to become more confident speaking, we’re here to help you move forward, one conversation at a time.
about.built1: Everyone learns differently. That’s why Amerivo isn’t built around a one-size-fits-all classroom.
about.built2: Our platform is designed to give learners the flexibility to choose learning that fits their goals, schedule, level, and lifestyle. You can learn from wherever you are, connect with the teacher who fits your needs, and focus on the English that actually matters to you.
about.builtMotto: Your goals. Your schedule. Your learning journey.
about.more1: We don’t want English learning to feel like another obligation. We want it to become something you can actually use.
about.more2: Our approach focuses on practical communication and meaningful interaction, not simply getting the right answer on a worksheet. Through conversation and personalized instruction, learners can work toward becoming more comfortable with:
about.community1: English connects people across countries, cultures, and backgrounds. Amerivo was created with that idea at its heart.
about.community2: Our goal is to make quality English learning accessible to people wherever they are, and to create a learning environment where different backgrounds are welcomed and respected.
about.communityMotto: Different countries. Different experiences. One shared language.
about.teachers1: Great learning starts with great teachers. Amerivo works with qualified American English instructors who bring their own experience, teaching style, and perspective to every lesson.
about.teachers2: Rather than placing every learner into the same program, we believe students should have the opportunity to find a teacher whose approach works for them.
about.teachers3: Our teachers are here to guide, encourage, correct, explain, and most importantly help you become a more confident communicator.
about.mission: To make practical, personalized English learning accessible to more people around the world.
about.mission2: We want to help learners develop the confidence to communicate, pursue opportunities, build relationships, and participate more fully in an increasingly connected world.
about.vision1: Amerivo is starting with English, but our vision is bigger than a language lesson. We’re building a platform where technology and human instruction work together to make learning more flexible, more personal, and more accessible.
about.vision2: As Amerivo grows, we want to continue improving the experience for both learners and teachers while building a community centered around learning, connection, and opportunity.
about.ctaText: Better English can lead to bigger opportunities. Whether you’re taking your first English lesson or working toward becoming a more confident speaker, Amerivo English is here to help you take the next step.

faq.metaDescription: Answers for students and teachers: lessons, prices, cancellations, payments, safety and becoming an Amerivo teacher.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Whether you’re looking for a teacher or ready to start teaching, here’s what you need to know about Amerivo English.

whatIs.a: Amerivo is an online English-learning platform that connects students with qualified American English teachers. You can browse teacher profiles, compare teaching styles and prices, check availability, book lessons, and learn online.

findTeacher.q: How do I find a teacher?
findTeacher.a: Browse teacher profiles and use the filters to find someone who matches your goals, availability and budget. You can watch each teacher’s introduction video and read their profile, qualifications and student reviews before booking. After the free placement test, we also recommend teachers for your level and goals.

chooseTeacher.q: Can I choose my own teacher?
chooseTeacher.a: Yes. You choose the teacher you want to learn with based on their profile, availability, experience, price, and teaching style.

languages.a: Amerivo is dedicated to English, taught by American English teachers.

online.a: Yes. Lessons take place in Amerivo’s online video classroom, directly in your browser — nothing to install. The classroom opens 5 minutes before your lesson.

duration.a: Lessons last 50 minutes. Some teachers also offer a free 20-minute trial lesson.

price.a: Teachers set their own price, between $20 and $50 per 50-minute lesson. The price is shown on each teacher’s profile before you book.

packages.a: Yes. You can book a single lesson, or a package of 5 or 10 lessons with the same teacher when the teacher offers it (5% and 10% off).

cancel.a: Yes. If you cancel more than 24 hours before the lesson, you get a full refund. Less than 24 hours before, the lesson is not refunded. To change the time, cancel and book a new slot.

teacherCancels.q: What happens if my teacher cancels?
teacherCancels.a: You get a full refund, and you can book another time with the same teacher or choose another teacher.

message.q: Can I message a teacher before booking?
message.a: Yes. You can message teachers through Amerivo to discuss your goals and expectations. For everyone’s safety, sharing personal contact details is not allowed, and all lessons and payments stay on Amerivo.

payments.a: You pay securely through Amerivo when you book, by card or other methods offered by our payment provider, Stripe. Amerivo never sees your full card number.

refund.a: Cancellations follow the 24-hour rule above. If something went wrong during a lesson, report it from your lesson page within 24 hours after the lesson: our team reviews it and refunds you when it’s justified.

who.a: Amerivo works with qualified American English teachers who want to teach students online. You’ll be asked about your experience, education, qualifications, and teaching background during the application.

become.q: How do I become an Amerivo teacher?
become.a: Create a teacher account and complete the application: your profile, a short introduction video, an identity check, and an interview with our team. Your profile becomes visible to students once it’s approved.

experience.a: Relevant teaching experience, education, certifications, and other qualifications are considered during the application.

price.q: Can I set my own price?
price.a: Yes. You choose your price per 50-minute lesson, between $20 and $50, and whether you offer a free trial lesson and lesson packages.

paid.a: You keep 75% of the lesson price; Amerivo’s commission is 25%. Your earnings become available once the lesson is completed and are paid through Stripe automatically on the 28th of each month, or earlier on request (from $20).

schedule.q: Can I choose my own schedule?
schedule.a: Yes. You set your weekly availability, block dates, and turn on vacation mode whenever you need.

countries.q: Can I teach students from different countries?
countries.a: Yes. Amerivo connects teachers and students internationally, subject to applicable laws, payment availability, and platform requirements.

minimum.q: Do I have to teach a minimum number of hours?
minimum.a: No. Amerivo does not require a minimum teaching schedule unless otherwise stated in your teacher agreement.

otherPlatforms.q: Can I teach on other platforms?
otherPlatforms.a: Yes, but students you meet on Amerivo must keep booking and paying through Amerivo. Moving them to another platform or to private lessons is not allowed (Terms of Service, section 8).

communicate.q: Can I communicate with my students through Amerivo?
communicate.a: Yes. You can message your students, chat and share notes during lessons, write lesson reports, and share documents once our team has approved them.

how.q: How does an Amerivo lesson work?
how.a: 1. Find a teacher. 2. Review their profile and availability. 3. Choose a time. 4. Book and pay. 5. Join your online lesson. 6. Continue learning with your teacher, or try another teacher whenever you want.

tryDifferent.a: Yes. You are not locked into one teacher — you can choose different teachers based on your goals and preferences.

review.a: Yes. After a completed lesson, you can rate it and leave a review. Reviews must reflect genuine experiences and follow our community guidelines.

protect.a: Teachers are reviewed and identity-verified before they can teach. Payments go through Stripe. Messages, classroom chat and shared documents are checked automatically, and personal contact details are hidden. You can report any inappropriate behavior directly from your messages or the classroom, and our team reviews every report.

record.a: No. Lessons are not recorded. The classroom chat and shared notes are kept with the lesson.

problem.q: What happens if I have a problem with a teacher or student?
problem.a: Use the “Report” button in your messages or in the classroom, or write to contact@amerivoenglish.com. Our team reviews safety issues, inappropriate behavior, payment issues, cancellations, and violations of our policies.

why.a: Amerivo was created to make online English learning more accessible, while giving teachers a better way to connect with students and manage their teaching.

international.a: Yes. Amerivo is designed for an international community of learners and teachers. Availability may depend on location, payment methods, and applicable laws.

school.a: No. Amerivo is an online marketplace and technology platform that connects students with independent English teachers. Teachers are responsible for the instruction they provide.

employ.a: No. Teachers on Amerivo are independent contractors, not employees of Amerivo.

contact.a: Use our contact page, e-mail contact@amerivoenglish.com, or call +1 317 516 7573.

faq.stillText: We’re building Amerivo English around the needs of both students and teachers. If you can’t find the answer you’re looking for, our team will be happy to help.
